page_title: QAT 1-3 SEN | Qatar v Senegal 25/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Senegal force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+6' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal).
90+6' Bamba Dieng (Senegal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Senegal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+4' Almoez Ali (Qatar) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the left post.
90+3' Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Meshaal Barsham intercepts the ball.
90+1' Assim Omer Madibo (Qatar) sees a yellow card from Antonio Mateu Lahoz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Close! Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
87' A yellow card for a tackle by Pathe Ciss (Senegal). Antonio Mateu Lahoz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
86' Senegal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
84' 1 - 3 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Iliman Ndiaye finds Bamba Dieng (Senegal) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:3.
83' Tarek Salman (Qatar) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Homam Ahmed.
83' Here is a change. Pedro Miguel is going off and Felix Sanchez Bas gives the last tactical orders to Mohammed Waad (Qatar).
80' Pape Abou Cisse (Senegal) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked.
80' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

80' Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. Senegal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

78' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Mohammed Muntari (Qatar) makes it 1:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Ismaeel Mohammad and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Edouard Mendy was helpless.
78' Here's the change. Nampalys Mendy leaves the pitch and Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal) comes on as a substitute.
78' It will be a substitution. Pape Abou Cisse (Senegal) is ready to enter the pitch as Ismail Jakobs walks off.
76' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) is penalised for a foul. Antonio Mateu Lahoz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
74' Aliou Cisse has decided to make a change. Bamba Dieng (Senegal) replaces Famara Diedhiou.
74' Aliou Cisse prepares a substitution. Ismaila Sarr is replaced by Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal).
74' That's the end of the game for Hasan Al Haydos, who is replaced by Mohammed Muntari (Qatar).
73' The resulting corner from Abdulaziz Hatem (Qatar) comes to nothing.
73' Boualem Khoukhi (Qatar) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play and Qatar manage to earn a corner.
72' Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle after Nampalys Mendy (Senegal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Qatar have a free kick.
69' Close! Nampalys Mendy (Senegal) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
69' Substitution. Karim Boudiaf leaves the pitch and is replaced by Abdulaziz Hatem (Qatar).
68' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

67' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Qatar will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

67' The ball is crossed into the box and Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the left side of the goal, but Edouard Mendy gets a glove on it to thwart him. Qatar force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
64' Substitution. Pathe Ciss (Senegal) has come on for Krepin Diatta.
63' Akram Afif (Qatar) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

63' Akram Afif (Qatar) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The ball is out of play. Qatar will have a chance to score from a corner.

63' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Almoez Ali (Qatar) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Edouard Mendy pulls off a brilliant save. Qatar will take a corner kick.
62' Akram Afif (Qatar) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!
61' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
57' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
56' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) controls the ball inside the six-yard box after the resulting free kick, but his effort is blocked by his teammate.
54' Poor challenge! Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) is penalised for tripping and Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle. Qatar have a free kick.
52' Today's referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz rightly decides to book Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) for his harsh tackle.
52' The linesman's flag goes up. Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) is caught in the offside trap.
50' Famara Diedhiou (Senegal) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows for a foul.

48' 0 - 2 Famara Diedhiou (Senegal) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Ismail Jakobs. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 0:2.
48' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) takes the corner.
48' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Senegal are awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+8' Antonio Mateu Lahoz blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Edouard Mendy displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Almoez Ali (Qatar) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
45+4' Akram Afif (Qatar) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45+4' Akram Afif (Qatar) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Qatar.
45+3' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) sends a cross into the box, but Meshaal Barsham comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+2' Antonio Mateu Lahoz shows a yellow card to Homam Ahmed (Qatar), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
44' Famara Diedhiou (Senegal) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
41' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Boulaye Dia (Senegal), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
39' The Senegal players are exchanging some short passes.
37' Krepin Diatta (Senegal) commits a foul and Antonio Mateu Lahoz immediately signals a free kick.
35' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Boulaye Dia picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
34' Akram Afif (Qatar) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
33' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' Homam Ahmed (Qatar) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Boulaye Dia (Senegal) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Mateu Lahoz ignores the protests.
30' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) picks up a long through ball, but Meshaal Barsham deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
29' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the right post.
28' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
27' Krepin Diatta (Senegal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Senegal force their opponents to concede a corner.
26' Abdelkarim Hassan (Qatar) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
25' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) tries to find Youssouf Sabaly, but he puts too much power on the pass.
24' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Meshaal Barsham scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
22' Ismail Jakobs (Senegal) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
22' Almoez Ali (Qatar) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Senegal.
21' Youssouf Sabaly (Senegal) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Qatar will have a goal kick.
20' Antonio Mateu Lahoz shows the yellow card to Ismaeel Mohammad (Qatar) for a heavy challenge.
19' Abdou Diallo (Senegal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) is able to continue to play.
17' Pedro Miguel (Qatar) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' The game is interrupted now, Abdou Diallo (Senegal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Famara Diedhiou (Senegal) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post.
16' Krepin Diatta (Senegal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

16' What a wasted opportunity by Krepin Diatta (Senegal)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Meshaal Barsham makes an astonishing save to thwart him. Senegal have been awarded a corner kick.
15' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Akram Afif (Qatar) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar.
15' Hasan Al Haydos (Qatar) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

14' The game is interrupted. Kalidou Koulibaly (Senegal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Qatar have been awarded a free kick.
12' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) passes the ball onto Krepin Diatta, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
10' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Krepin Diatta (Senegal) heads on.
9' Nampalys Mendy (Senegal) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles wide of the left post.
6' Akram Afif (Qatar) is flagged for offside.
4' The opposition can't get near Ismaila Sarr (Senegal), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
3' Kalidou Koulibaly (Senegal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Qatar will have the kick-off.
Antonio Mateu Lahoz will officiate today.
